confidence_notes: I checked inexpensive-meal, cappuccino and draft-beer prices with one web search, which found 2026 aggregator data in Swedish kronor (SEK): about SEK 120-150 for an inexpensive meal, SEK 40-70 for a cappuccino (sources disagree) and SEK 60-80 for a 0.5 L draft. I converted these to USD at an assumed rate of about 9.4 SEK per USD. That rate comes from general knowledge, not a search, so all food and drink anchors share that uncertainty. I did not search for the mid-range meal for two, cocktail or wine prices. These are my estimates based on Swedish price relationships: the mid-range meal is about 900 SEK, and the cocktail and wine are scaled up from the beer price, roughly twice beer for a cocktail and about 1.5 times beer for wine. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates for Gothenburg's July summer peak from general knowledge. I did not check any live booking pages, so these are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are consistent with Swedish urban averages, with Gothenburg slightly above the national average and a little below Stockholm. Copenhagen and Oslo are pricier Nordic comparisons used as a reference for accommodation.
